method: librosa pYIN65–1000Hz, mono22.05kHz,2048frame/256hop; source is full mix; no vocal separation
interpretation: Pitch comparison rejected as unreliable: medians near65Hz lower bound and median voiced probabilities about0.01. Do not use correlation/cents as evidence of preserved or changed melody. Gross duration measured only.
limitations: Source is a mixed generated song, so dominant instrumental pitches may drive pYIN.
No reliable source-vocal F0 reference; octave errors and voiced-mask mismatches possible.
Frame estimates are not musical note alignment or singer identity evidence.
No singing, diction or perceptual quality success is established.
